identity.title: [v0.92][WP-02B][build] Run the post-migration build acceleration experiment

values.summary: Use the seven retained 16-core measurements to select the test-only command structure, route adl-rust-tests to the 16-core runner, remove the dispatch-only experiment harness, and require the implementation PR as the production canary.

steps.action: Verify migration, budget, runner-group, selected-repository, concurrency-one, and rollback gates
Retain one cold, three warm, and three test-only 16-core measurements and recompute the bounded decision
Route adl-rust-tests to the selected runner, remove experiment-only machinery, validate, and require a green production canary

invariants: Standard GitHub-hosted runners remain the default and immediate fallback
Exact-head validation and proof quality are independent of runner class
Required-check names and branch protection remain stable
No tracked work occurs on main
No sample or error is silently discarded
risks: Cache asymmetry produces a false speedup
Paid runner access or secrets widen beyond the selected repository
A canary changes required-check identity or proof semantics
Migration or CI instability confounds the experiment
stop_conditions: WP-02 or WP-02A entry evidence is incomplete
Budget, alerts, selected-repository access, or rollback cannot be verified
The comparison inputs cannot be held constant
Untrusted code can reach privileged runner context
replan_triggers: GitHub changes available runner sizes or larger-runner billing
WP-02A changes the control workflow or selected lane topology
The frozen workflow, toolchain, lockfile, cache, permission, or required-check inputs drift
The organization owner changes thresholds before the first measured run
